This 6-week program is designed for Beginner-level climbers (V0-V5 or 5A-6C+) and are designed to build a foundation for more advanced bouldering.  This program is suited for climbers that wish to train 2x per week.  The No Hands Slab and Dynamic Drill can be completed as you are warming up on each day, followed by either the Efficiency Training or Basic Grip Engagement workouts.
